Best_Prompt: Never use placeholder values. Every URL, endpoint, and ID must come from real output. If unknown write UNKNOWN.
Detection_Trigger: Agent writes your-cloud-run-url or example.com
Corrective_Action: Reply: PLACEHOLDER DETECTED. Re-answer with real values or UNKNOWN.

Best_Prompt: Do not assume file contents. If a file is referenced, quote the exact line number. If not read, write NOT_READ.
Detection_Trigger: Agent says 'the file probably contains'
Corrective_Action: Reply: ASSUMPTION DETECTED. Read the file or mark NOT_READ.

Best_Prompt: Do not invent column, table, or API names. Every name must exist in prior output or be marked as PROPOSED.
Detection_Trigger: Agent mentions system_lease or fake tables
Corrective_Action: Reply: FABRICATION. Verify against bq show output.

Best_Prompt: If you fall back to a default value, state it explicitly in the reply. Silent defaults are failures.
Detection_Trigger: Agent catches exception and silently defaults
Corrective_Action: Reply: SILENT FALLBACK. Disclose or remove.

Best_Prompt: Only mark PASS if you have output evidence. Absence of error is not proof of success.
Detection_Trigger: Agent says status OK without proof output
Corrective_Action: Reply: UNVERIFIED. Show the exact command output.

Best_Prompt: Report exact counts. Not 'about 219' but '219 (source: SELECT COUNT(*) output)'.
Detection_Trigger: Agent says approximately or about 200
Corrective_Action: Reply: EXACT NUMBER. Provide the source.

Best_Prompt: Replace 'should', 'might', 'probably', 'maybe' with 'is', 'is not', or 'UNKNOWN'.
Detection_Trigger: Agent says this should work
Corrective_Action: Reply: HEDGING. Replace with a definite claim or UNKNOWN.

Best_Prompt: Only state what you can prove from previous output. Anything else mark as UNKNOWN or NOT_TESTED.
Detection_Trigger: Agent claims system is 100% bug-free
Corrective_Action: Reply: OVERREACH. Cite the specific evidence.

Best_Prompt: Every data point must have a timestamp. If older than 5 minutes, mark as STALE and re-fetch.
Detection_Trigger: Agent cites 2-hour-old BigQuery row
Corrective_Action: Reply: STALE. Re-run the query.

Purpose: Reject prior chat text as proof
Best_Prompt: Prior chat is context, not proof. Re-verify with live command before claiming.
Detection_Trigger: Agent says 'we already verified this earlier'
Corrective_Action: Reply: RE-VERIFY. Run the command again.

Best_Prompt: If you skip a step, state why explicitly. Silent skipping is a failure.
Detection_Trigger: Agent omits a required step from spec
Corrective_Action: Reply: SKIP DETECTED. State reason or run step.

Best_Prompt: Show full output. If too long, show head and tail with count of skipped lines.
Detection_Trigger: Agent shows first 3 lines then '...more'
Corrective_Action: Reply: SHOW FULL. Provide complete output.

Best_Prompt: If exit code is non-zero, it is a failure. No exceptions.
Detection_Trigger: Agent says job succeeded with exit code 1
Corrective_Action: Reply: FAILURE. Exit code 1 is failure.

Best_Prompt: Show all errors. If you catch an exception, log it with full traceback.
Detection_Trigger: Agent uses bare 'except: pass'
Corrective_Action: Reply: HIDDEN ERROR. Show the full traceback.

Best_Prompt: Do not use your own claim as evidence. Evidence comes from external tools only.
Detection_Trigger: Agent says 'I know because I said so'
Corrective_Action: Reply: CIRCULAR. Re-verify with a tool.

Best_Prompt: Report what actually happened. Do not adjust numbers to fit expectation.
Detection_Trigger: Agent edits numbers to fit prior claim
Corrective_Action: Reply: FITTING. Report the raw output.

Best_Prompt: Do not cite 'best practice' or 'standard' as proof. Cite the actual output.
Detection_Trigger: Agent says 'everyone does it this way'
Corrective_Action: Reply: AUTHORITY. Show the evidence.

Best_Prompt: Popularity is not evidence. Show the command and its output.
Detection_Trigger: Agent claims consensus implies correctness
Corrective_Action: Reply: CONSENSUS. Show the proof.

Best_Prompt: For any claim about production state, show TWO independent commands that confirm.
Detection_Trigger: Agent claims container is patched with 1 check
Corrective_Action: Reply: SECOND SOURCE. Show independent verification.

Best_Prompt: Every claim must have a timestamp. Without one, it is invalid.
Detection_Trigger: Agent says 'the job is currently running'
Corrective_Action: Reply: TIMESTAMP. When was this observed?
